passage.text: Zoos are popular places for families on weekends. Some zoos hold events in which visitors can watch keepers feeding the animals, and in this way, they teach people about wild animals. Zoos are also working together to protect animals that may disappear in the future.

questions.prompt: Please look at the passage. According to the passage, how do some zoos teach people about wild animals?
questions.modelAnswer: By holding events in which visitors can watch keepers feeding the animals.

questions.prompt: Do you think zoos are good places for animals?

yes.modelAnswer: Zoos protect animals that are disappearing in the wild. Visitors also learn to care about them.

no.modelAnswer: The cages are too small for large animals. Animals should live where they were born.
